description_en: Deactivates blackhole filtering for a protected IP address
description_zh: 为单个受保护IP解除黑洞状态
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp delete-blackhole --ip 47.89.XX.XX --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBlackhole

parameters.help_en:
The IP address for which you want to deactivate blackhole filtering.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118701.html operation to query all the IP addresses that are protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance and the protection status of the IP addresses. For example, you can query whether blackhole filtering is triggered for an IP address
parameters.help_zh:
要解除黑洞状态的受保护IP。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118701.html查询所有受DDoS原生防护实例保护的IP资产及IP的防护状态（IP是否处于黑洞状态）
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
